Who We Are 
 At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. 
 We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. 
 We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. 
 Our Values 
 If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. 
 Department 
 People
 Who You Are 
 Reporting to the Senior Manager, People Strategy Operations, the Senior AI Engineer, People, is a technical founder embedded within the People function. 
 You have a track record of shipping internal tools and AI-powered workflows that people actually use. You're as comfortable mapping a team’s AI gaps and designing a solution as you are vibe-coding a working prototype with an AI agent. You're insatiably curious and never satisfied with the status quo — you operate with urgency and agency, center the customer in every decision, and make every team you join better. You think in systems, move fast, and know how to bring people along without manufacturing consensus. You don’t need to come from HR. You need to care about building tools that make people’s work lives better.
 This is a true engineering role. We are looking for someone with production experience shipping AI systems — not someone who uses AI tools, but someone who builds them. Senior here means senior by organizational reach and shipped impact, not by years of CS experience.

 Scan externally for emerging AI capabilities and market patterns; translate signal into written briefs that inform what the team experiments on next.
 Embed long-term operational success by creating reproducible blueprints, demos, and guides that naturally transfer expertise and cultivate sustainable AI ownership across the People team.
